title_zh: 根据照片背面说明更正亲属标注

scenario.label_zh: 根据照片原注更正家族人物标注
scenario.goal_zh: 核对照片背面的姓名与亲属关系，确定更正后的相册说明并保留原注副本

context_zh: 艾米和叔叔萨米尔整理家族相册，查看一张旧照片及背面的原有说明。
author: author-phase06-a

sentences.speaker: Amy
sentences.text: Remind me who the man beside Grandma is. This album calls him her brother.

sentences.speaker: Samir
sentences.text: That is Farid, her cousin. He was our oldest living relative when that picture was taken.

sentences.speaker: Amy
sentences.text: Are we related to the woman beside him too?

sentences.speaker: Samir
sentences.text: No, she was his neighbour. Turn the photograph over; Grandma wrote their names on the back.

sentences.speaker: Amy
sentences.text: Yes, it says, "My cousin Farid and our neighbour Salma." The album was originally labelled by someone who did not know them.

sentences.speaker: Samir
sentences.text: Then we should correct the caption and keep a photograph of Grandma's note with it.

sentences.speaker: Amy
sentences.text: I will change it to "Grandma with her cousin Farid and their neighbour Salma." Does that match the note?

sentences.speaker: Samir
sentences.text: It does. Use that caption and put the copy of the note on the next page.
